race.comment: OUTBACK THUNDER (4) was speedy out of box 3 on debut to score by 1.75 lengths (22.17) at this track over 380m. Expected to go close again. RADCLIFF (1) was out of the placings latest but three back was a Maiden winner in quick time (21.97) at this track in a Maiden. Well placed here and can atone this time. FARMOR FREEDOM (7) beaten last start over the 407m at Rockhampton but finished in the minors in a quick 23.74. Fast run latest and rates a key player again. ACTION MAN (2) collected a minor prize last start and must be considered.
